messages:
maya: heads-up — during the int4 bringup for magnet-7b-long I noticed a tiny but reproducible divergence when resuming longprefill around the 4k token boundary. looks like 'ghost' tokens appear in the output (weird repeats) :eyes:

owen: hmm, can you paste an example and the exact config you used?

maya: repro steps below. pretty short thread: run the smoke runner with the prefill script, then resume with kv caching.
```
# repro (local runner)
./run_eval --model magnet-7b-long-int4v2 --quant int4 --rope-scaling auto --prefill-file tests/long_prefill/6k_prompt.txt \
  --resume-with-kv true --kv-window 8192 --seed 42
```
logs:
...token 3998: "and then"
...token 4001: "and then and then"   <-- duplicate fragment
...token 4010: hallucinated small phrase not in prompt
```

liam: interesting. does this only show up with `rope-scaling auto`? try forcing `rope-scaling none` or `scale=1.0`?

maya: good call. with `--rope-scaling none` the ghosting disappears in the short repro. with `auto` it reproduces consistently.

zhen: could be the rollforward heuristic that tries to remap rotary indices when context grows past training window. if the kv indices are not rolled forward consistently across shards we might be reading stale kv entries.

owen: are you running on single shard or multi-shard config?

maya: single-GPU for the initial test. I also ran a two-shard run and saw the same symptom but less frequent.

liam: do we have a quick checksum diff of KV keys before/after resume? sometimes quant memcpy padding can shift offsets.

maya: i dumped the kv keys (hex) for layer 10 before and after resume. offsets match but values differ slightly at a few positions after the boundary. attaching snippet: `KV_LAYER10_HEX_DIFF: 0x1a2b.. 0x1a2f..`

eval-bot: CI run 4260001300 completed: magnet-7b-long-int4v2 smoke (prefill=6k) — divergence detected (delta BLEU 0.04) — logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4260001300

zhen: BLEU change is small but the repeat/hallucination pattern makes me suspect kv alignment + rotary phase rollforward. Two hypotheses: 1) rope_scale computed from sequence length is non-deterministic under quant memcpy and causes index misalignment; 2) the rollforward code path updates positional indices but KV cache still serves older entries because of stale tag (race).

owen: quick experiment idea: run with `--kv-verify-checksum` which validates KV digest on resume; if checksum fails we can catch corruption. also try `--disable-rollforward` flag (dev build) to see if that eliminates the issue.

maya: running both now locally. will report after the 3 runs (none, checksum, disable-rollforward). ETA ~20m.

liam: also try toggling `--kv-window` between 4096 and 8192; if it's related to window wrapping we might see different frequency.

maya: update:
- run A (`rope-scaling auto`, kv-window 8192): ghosting reproduces (~4/10 runs).
- run B (`rope-scaling auto`, kv-window 4096): ghosting frequency increases (~7/10).
- run C (`disable-rollforward`): ghosting disappears in 20/20 runs.

zhen: that strongly implicates rollforward. good catch.

owen: can you capture a minimal trace with `--trace-kv-ops` (records prefill/resume ops + tags) and upload to the shared bucket? prefix it with `rollforward-426000`

maya: uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/rollforward-426000/trace.tar.gz

liam: I'll take a look at the trace. initial suspicion: rollforward increments rotary position base, but the tag/version used for kv entries isn't bumped until after a late memcpy, so resume reads mismatched kv entries for a window slice.

zhen: also note this only surfaces under int4 layout because memcpy pad bytes shift the alignment of the kv buffer. under fp16 we didn't see it.

nowen: plan: 1) add an assert to ensure KV tag/version increments atomically with rollforward; 2) add a unit test that resumes with artificial misaligned memcpy padding; 3) keep `disable-rollforward` as a temporary mitigation in canary if needed.

maya: will open a PR with repro + failing unit test and link here. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6243 (WIP) — includes `--kv-verify-checksum` helper and the failing test.

eval-bot: added label: regression/kv-rollforward to run 4260001300

liam: after PR lands we should run a small canary on dedicated pool with real traffic and monitor for any increase in error or hallucination rate.

maya: noted. i'll coordinate with infra for canary.

owen: great thread. short and focused. once we have the unit test we can iterate on atomicity fix.

zhen: optional: also check rotary implementation when `rope-scaling auto` uses interpolation/upsample; edge interpolation + quant can be a subtle source of phase drift.

maya: yep adding that to the checklist. will follow up with more logs after PR.
